name: Deep Industries Ltd
tagline: Oil & gas services (workover rigs, gas compression, CBM/PEC catalysts) whose 'negative recent returns' were actually a one-off non-cash legacy-receivables write-off -- Q1 FY27 shows a genuine operating inflection (+44% PAT, 100% fleet utilization, Rs3,047cr order book), but real ONGC-relationship and legacy-receivables overhangs remain live
business_overview: Deep Industries provides oilfield/gas services including workover rigs and gas processing facilities on a charter-hire (turnkey) model, with exposure to India's coal-bed methane (CBM) and national gas-grid expansion.
fundamentals_table: Recent-period -4.8%/-1.6% distorted by a one-off non-cash Rs208.28cr write-off (Kandla Energy legacy receivables); 3-yr avg ROE 12.4%; Q1FY27 PAT +44.48% YoY signals a genuine operating recovery
FY26 +55% YoY to Rs891cr (pre-exceptional PBT +65% to Rs348cr); Q1FY27 +40% YoY to Rs278.9cr

Rs3,047cr consolidated as of 30-Jun-2026 (~3.4x FY26 revenue); >60% executable over next 2-2.5 years; FY27 revenue guidance ~Rs1,100cr, ~Rs800cr of FY27 execution from backlog; FY28 PAT target ~Rs500cr (management)
Rs90.6cr unsecured loan to sister concern Prabha Energy (same promoter group) at 12% interest

ONGC provisional business-suspension notice (drilling-rig contract, alleged nonperformance linked to the Jan-2026 Mori-5 gas-leak incident) -- contested under Force Majeure/arbitration; partial relief granted Mar-2026 excluding gas compression/dehydration/other drilling-rig-hiring services
fundamentals_narrative: The negative recent-period ROE/ROCE (-4.8%/-1.6%) previously recorded was distorted by a one-off, non-cash Rs208.28cr write-off of legacy trade receivables inherited from the Kandla Energy merger, which hit reported FY26 numbers even as FY26 consolidated revenue grew 55% YoY to Rs891cr and pre-exceptional PBT grew 65% to Rs348cr. Q1 FY27 clarifies the underlying trend is genuinely strong: revenue +40% YoY to Rs278.9cr, EBITDA Rs131.8cr (43.6% margin), PAT +44.48% YoY to Rs89.14cr, with 100% fleet utilization and a Rs3,047cr consolidated order book (>60% executable over the next 2-2.5 years). Set against this is a live ONGC provisional business-suspension dispute (alleged nonperformance tied to the Jan-2026 Mori-5 gas-leak incident, contested by the company as Force Majeure, partial relief granted Mar-2026) and Rs161.11cr of pre-acquisition Dolphin Offshore legacy receivables under arbitration -- both real, unresolved counterparty/recoverability risks with the company's single largest customer relationship. A Rs90.6cr unsecured loan to sister concern Prabha Energy (12% interest) is a related-party item worth ongoing scrutiny.

verdict_headline: A genuine operating inflection (Q1FY27: +44% PAT, 100% utilization, Rs3,047cr order book) clarifies the prior 'negative returns' bear case was a one-off write-off, not a real decline -- but a live ONGC relationship dispute and legacy-receivables arbitration keep this from a higher conviction
verdict_reasoning: The previously-recorded negative recent-period ROE/ROCE was an artifact of a one-off, non-cash Rs208.28cr legacy-receivables write-off, not operating deterioration -- FY26 pre-exceptional PBT actually grew 65% YoY, and Q1FY27 confirms the clean trend (+44% PAT YoY, 100% fleet utilization)

Order book (Rs3,047cr, ~3.4x FY26 revenue) and management's own FY27/FY28 targets give real, evidenced revenue visibility -- four_box tailwind upgraded weak->yes and valuation upgraded weak->yes (P/E ~18-19x against +44% PAT growth is undemanding)

But the ONGC provisional-suspension dispute (still under arbitration, only partially resolved) and Rs161.11cr of separate legacy Dolphin receivables also under arbitration are real, live, unresolved risks with the company's largest counterparty -- not yet a formal red-flag-tier trigger (no promoter-holding collapse or auditor resignation found), but genuine enough to keep conviction capped
A Rs90.6cr unsecured related-party loan to sister concern Prabha Energy is a governance watch-item flagged this pass, not previously captured

four_box score improved 1.5 -> 3.0 (tailwind yes, tam/moat weak, valuation yes), clearing the >=3.0 threshold -- thesis_fit set to '10x-in-2-3-years' at Medium conviction, not higher, given the unresolved ONGC/receivables overhangs
